name: Gerlachov (Poprad District, Slovakia)
description: A blue field with a saltire whose arms are split lengthwise white and black, ending at the fly in three tails formed by two swallowtail notches reaching one third of the flag's length.
history: The flag's colours are taken from the municipal arms, as required for Slovak municipal symbols; arms and flag are registered in the Heraldic Register of the Slovak Republic under signature G-10/96.
